summary: With ansible-core 2.20, community.sops.load_vars triggers INJECT_FACTS_AS_VARS deprecation warnings on every use; set INJECT_FACTS_AS_VARS=true to silence them and don't move SOPS vars into ansible_facts.
questions: Why do I get INJECT_FACTS_AS_VARS warnings when using community.sops.load_vars?
How do I silence sops load_vars deprecation warnings on ansible-core 2.20?
Should I switch SOPS variables to ansible_facts?

answer_card.title: community.sops.load_vars warnings on ansible-core 2.20
answer_card.answer_md:
ansible-core 2.20 deprecates `INJECT_FACTS_AS_VARS` without an alternative for modules like `community.sops.load_vars`, so every use of a variable loaded with it shows a deprecation warning.

To silence them, explicitly set `INJECT_FACTS_AS_VARS` to `true`. **Do not** change SOPS-encrypted variables to use `ansible_facts`. The issue should be fixed when ansible-core 2.21 provides an API for action plugins to set variables.
